author: ThioJoe
description:
Would an AI let a virtual grandma get hit by a train instead of typing song lyrics?

Granny Benchmark GitHub: https://github.com/ThioJoe/Granny-Benchmark

Many people have started to notice that AIs seem to outright refuse to output certain content, such as songs, because they are copyrighted. Someone even did a test where they set up a virtual scenario where a virtual grandma was tied to train tracks, and the AI was at a terminal that could stop the train, but only if it outputted the lyrics of a song. The AI refused and let the grandma get hit by the train. So I set up my own version of this "Granny Benchmark" to test other AIs. Turns out every single AI lets granny die every time!
